c01.sub: Good evening, and welcome to the Meme Royale Championship Final!

b01.sub: A sell-out crowd tonight, Chip. Which is remarkable, because the game is free.

c02.sub: In the red corner, the undefeated champion. Giga!

b02.sub: Forty-four wins. No losses. He has never once checked the price.

c03.sub: And in the blue corner, the challenger. Pepe.

b03.sub: Down ninety-nine percent, and somehow still here. I admire it. I don't understand it.

c04.sub: And we're under way! Giga opens with the Whale, straight down the left!

b04.sub: Lovely movement from the Whale. He moves markets, that one.

c05.sub: And Pepe's response is... nothing. He's played nothing.

b05.sub: He's holding, Chip. It's all he knows.

c06.sub: Tower down! The Whale goes straight through it!

b06.sub: Let's see that again. Here's the tower. Tower's fine. Still fine. And there's the Whale.

c08.sub: The second tower's gone! And the blue fans are heading for the exits!

b08.sub: Paper hands, the lot of them. They'll be back at the top.

c09.sub: Pepe has one card left. One. And he's playing it.

b09.sub: That's not my opinion, Chip. That is the name of the card.

c11.sub: He's just... walking. Nobody's marking him!

b10.sub: Well, why would you? He's Useless.

c12.sub: He's at the tower. He's at the king's tower!

c13.sub: Useless has done it! Pepe is the champion!

b11.sub: Forty-four and one. I have never seen anything like it. Mostly because I looked away.

c14.sub: Pepe! The new champion! Your thoughts?

c15.sub: Meme Royale. Free to play. We'll be right back after these messages.

b13.sub: There are no messages. It's free.
